definition.question: How fragmented and ineffective is international governance of frontier AI safety and incident response?
definition.low_end: Cohesive international AI safety norms and incident-response mechanisms effectively manage frontier risks.
definition.high_end: International AI safety governance is completely fractured with no shared norms and no capacity to contain cross-border AI incidents.

readings.rationale: Unassessed - no evidence in this batch on AI safety governance, standards, or incidents with state consequences; research needed on multilateral AI safety agreements, incident reporting, and regulatory divergence.
